You may feel overwhelmed, not know where to start, or struggle to find meaning in what you’re going through. In those moments, having a space to pause, breathe, and make sense of what’s happening can make all the difference. Therapy is not only for when “everything is falling apart,” it’s also a tool to know yourself better, make clearer decisions, and take conscious care of yourself.<1> My approach combines the emotional with the practical. It’s not just about talking, but about understanding how you work, why you feel the way you do, and what you can do to start feeling better. ","about2.content2":"<0>In our sessions we work with concrete tools, tailored to you, that help you face what worries you, improve your relationships, and restore your well-being. And all of this from a place of respect, active listening, and without judgment.<1>If you live abroad, have a busy schedule, or simply prefer the comfort of your home, online therapy can be a great option. It maintains the closeness and depth of therapeutic work, but with the flexibility you need. Life constantly challenges us, and we don’t always have the tools or support we need to face it. In individual therapy, we work together to understand what’s happening to you, ease your distress, and strengthen your personal resources.

","service.area.2.title":"Couples therapy","service.area.2.content":"

If you have questions or would like to explore other options, feel free to write to me — we’ll talk with no commitment.","slider.title.top":"Clinical psychologist","slider.title.bottom":"in Madrid and online","slider.title.slogan":"A professional space to care for your mental health and relationships","slider.cta":"Book your first session","stepper.title":"How therapy works","stepper.content":"

I know starting therapy can bring doubts, nerves, or even a bit of fear. That’s why I want you to know that the process is designed so you feel supported from the very first moment, with clarity, respect, and no pressure. Each step is adapted to you, your pace, and your needs.

","stepper.1.title":"First session","stepper.1.content":"<0>The first session is a space to share what brings you here, what worries you, and what you’d like to achieve.

You can also ask me about how I work, what to expect, and how sessions usually go. You don’t need to have it all figured out: we’ll explore it together.

","stepper.2.title":"Assessment and plan","stepper.2.content":"<0>After getting to know you better, we do an initial assessment to better understand your situation.

From there, I give you clear feedback and we design a personalized plan. This plan adapts to you, your goals, and how you evolve.

","stepper.3.title":"Therapy sessions","stepper.3.content":"<0>In each session we use practical, evidence-based tools you can apply in daily life.

It’s not just talking: you’ll learn strategies to manage what’s happening, make clearer decisions, and build lasting change.

","stepper.4.title":"Follow-up and closure","stepper.4.content":"<0>As you start feeling better, we review your progress and talk about how to keep caring for yourself outside of sessions.

The goal is for you to become more autonomous, with your own resources and a deeper self-understanding. Closure is a step forward, helping you sustain your well-being beyond sessions.

","stepper.footer.content":"<0>Confidentiality guaranteed Everything we talk about in session is protected by law. Your privacy and emotional safety are an absolute priority.","stepper.cta":"Start your process","teams.jobTitle":"Health Psychologist - M-42801","workOnline.category":"Online therapy","workOnline.title1":"Online therapy","workOnline.content1":"Online therapy is not a “plan B”; it is just as valid and effective as in-person therapy in most cases. In fact, many people prefer it for its convenience, flexibility, and the possibility of accessing psychological support no matter where they are.","workOnline.title2":"When can it be ideal?","workOnline.content2":"<0>If you live outside Madrid or in another country.<1>If you travel frequently and need continuity in your process.<2>If you have a busy schedule and need sessions to fit into your routine.<3>If you prefer to avoid commuting and save time.<4>With just a device with a camera, headphones, and a stable connection, you can have your session from home, the office, or even while traveling. What matters is not the place, but that you feel in a safe, comfortable, and interruption-free space.","workOnline.title3":"And what about the therapeutic bond?","workOnline.content3":"The emotional connection and depth of therapeutic work are not lost through a screen. My way of working ensures you feel heard, understood, and supported, wherever you are. It’s enough time for you to express yourself calmly, work in depth, and leave with clear ideas to apply in your daily life.","faq.q2":"How often should I come?","faq.a2":"At the beginning, it’s most common to have weekly sessions, as that allows continuity and more solid progress. Over time, depending on your progress, we can adjust the frequency: biweekly, monthly, or according to your needs.","faq.q3":"What if I don’t feel comfortable?","faq.a3":"It’s completely normal to have doubts or not feel entirely comfortable at first. You can tell me at any time. My priority is that the space adapts to you, and that you feel safe to talk about what truly matters to you. Therapy is a collaborative process, and your voice matters.","faq.q4":"Can I switch from online to in-person?","faq.a4":"Yes, of course. If at any point you prefer to move from online to in-person sessions (or vice versa), we can discuss and arrange it depending on availability and location. What’s important is that the format fits your life and makes the process easier for you.","faq.q5":"Is therapy confidential?","faq.a5":"Absolutely. Everything you share in session is protected by data protection law and the professional ethical code. Confidentiality is a fundamental basis of therapeutic work, and you can trust that your privacy is safeguarded.","faq.q6":"Do I need to prepare anything before coming?","faq.a6":"You don’t need to prepare anything. But if it helps, you can write down topics you’d like to discuss, questions you may have, or situations that concern you. Sometimes writing things down helps organize ideas and make the most of session time.","faq.q7":"How do I know if I need therapy?","faq.a7":"You don’t need to be “at your worst” to start therapy. Sometimes you just feel that something isn’t right, that it’s hard to manage certain emotions, or that you’d like to understand yourself better. Other times, there’s a specific situation that overwhelms you: a breakup, a big change, a loss, a conflict... Whatever it is, if you’re considering it, there’s probably something inside you asking to be heard. Therapy can help you if: • You feel stuck, confused, or blocked. • You’re going through a hard time and need emotional support. • You want to improve your relationship with yourself or others. • You struggle with decision-making or managing stress. • You simply want to know yourself better and live with more calm and clarity. You don’t need to have it all figured out to start. In fact, many times the first step is exactly that: allowing yourself to explore, without pressure or judgment.","faq.q8":"What if I don’t know where to start?","faq.a8":"That’s okay. In the first session you don’t need to have a prepared speech or know exactly what to say. You can come with your doubts, your silences, your questions. <5>Legal Basis<6>The legal basis for processing your data is your consent, which you give by submitting the form.<7>Data Retention

<9>Data Sharing

Your data will not be shared with third parties, except where legally required.

<1>

Correct inaccurate data.

<2>

Request the deletion of your data when it is no longer necessary.

<3>

Restrict or object to its processing.
